implementedEffectCrosswalk.trigger: Despair on player's actual attack, confirmed by GM
implementedEffectCrosswalk.consequence: 2 strain and lose one available maneuver

implementedEffectCrosswalk.trigger: Triumph remaining from actual successful player attack, confirmed by GM
implementedEffectCrosswalk.consequence: real target staggered for one round

implementedEffectCrosswalk.trigger: Advantage remaining from actual successful player attack, confirmed by GM
implementedEffectCrosswalk.consequence: real target disoriented for one round

implementedEffectCrosswalk.trigger: Advantage remaining from actual successful player attack, confirmed by GM
implementedEffectCrosswalk.consequence: one ranged setback against PC until the next round

limitations: Only one published effect per landscape implemented, not the full sixteen effects.
Symbols are never generated by this module; positive effects spend the actual pending attack ledger.
Alderaan requires a real player attack containing Despair and an unused maneuver.
Effects do not create new factions or simulate their arrival.
The PDF has an overlapping d100=47 boundary; existing GM adjudication is preserved.
No complete SWE09 semantic certification or Android physical test.
